preset: Lab: AES encrypt and decrypt (no radio)
description: Learning, no radio needed: real encryption. AES-128 in CTR mode scrambles the message (middle, shown as hex); the same key and nonce bring it back (right). Unlike a short XOR key, an AES key cannot be brute forced - 2^128 keys is beyond any computer. Change one hex digit of the key on the right to see the output turn to noise.
name: Lab AES encrypt decrypt
